meta.name: golang-patterns
meta.description: Go-specific design patterns and best practices including functional options, small interfaces, dependency injection, concurrency patterns, error handling, and package organization. Use when working with Go code to apply idiomatic Go patterns.

copy.tagline: 在 Go 项目中应用惯用设计模式与最佳实践
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果正在用 Go 写代码，想写出更地道、可维护的代码。
copy.tagline_en: Apply idiomatic Go design patterns and best practices in your projects
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you write Go code and want to make it more idiomatic and maintainable.

howto.what: 当你在 Go 项目中工作时，Claude 会提供 Go 特有的设计模式与最佳实践，包括函数选项、小接口、依赖注入、并发模式、错误处理和包组织等。
howto.when: 当你编写或修改 Go 代码（.go 文件）、go.mod 或 go.sum 文件时触发。

say.text: 用函数选项模式为我的 Server 结构体添加配置。
say.note: Claude 会生成 WithPort 等选项函数。

say.text: 帮我写一个 worker pool 处理并发任务。
say.note: Claude 会生成 worker pool 代码。

say.text: 用表驱动测试测试 Validate 函数。

howto.what_en: When working on Go projects, Claude provides Go-specific design patterns and best practices including functional options, small interfaces, dependency injection, concurrency patterns, error handling, and package organization.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you write or modify Go code (.go files), go.mod, or go.sum files.

say_en.text: Use functional options pattern to configure my Server struct.
Write a worker pool for concurrent tasks.
say_en.note: Claude will generate worker pool code.

say_en.text: Write a table-driven test for Validate function.
